comments:
The same manuscript was reproduced in [Z5AUD7GQ], vol. 11, and in [KUYBGM7V], vol. 69.
The identification of this instance with item No. 18965 in [8H6M69W4] (blo gros dri ma med pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i lam gyi rim pa) is tentative. This item is reported to have 29 folios (against no. 39 on the last folio for the manuscript in the bKa' gdams gsung 'bum). The signature is mistakenly reported as "phyi la 378" in the KDSB dkar chag.
